6.324 rsRowNumberInLookupDestinationOrResult
Applies to RDL 2010/01 and RDL 2016/01
rsRowNumberInLookupDestinationOrResult is a critical error that will occur when an expression within
the Destination or Result function parameter of a Lookup, LookupSet, or MultiLookup function uses a
RowNumber aggregate function.
